decisions: Domain activation is deferred until G3 and owner hostname/provider selection.
A marketing portfolio does not need an app subdomain or marketing email subdomain by default.
DMARC enforcement must wait until legitimate senders and alignment are verified.
risks: G3 remains open because mobile LCP exceeds the 2.5 second threshold.
No registrar, production hostname, sending provider, or Search Console account is selected.
open_questions: Owner must select a production hostname and provider when S7 is authorized.
next_instructions: Complete G3 before scheduling domain activation.
When S7 starts, coordinate deployment with domain-ops and live SEO validation with growth.
